purpose: Teach: 鎧/ネックレス/文房具/売場/選曲/見どころ/ピアス/葉書

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 祖父の鎧、まだ蔵にあるよ。
lines.en: Grandfather's armor is still in the storehouse.
lines.style: Quiet opening. Slow, steady pace. Voice carries the weight of time without sadness. Eyes looking inward and backward at once.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。結婚の時にもらったネックレス、宝物よ。
lines.en: Yes. The necklace he gave me when we married — it's my treasure.
lines.style: Soft agreement that blooms into tenderness. Warm breath behind the words. A small smile in the voice. Trailing gently on 'treasure' like she's holding it in her hands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の文房具、万年筆、今も愛用してる。
lines.en: Old stationery — that fountain pen, I still use it every day.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact affection. Light, almost conversational. The pride of practical loyalty. Small pause before the last phrase, like offering proof.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: デパートの売場、二人で歩いた日、懐かしいわ。
lines.en: Walking through the department store together — those days feel so far away now.
lines.style: Wistful but not mournful. Breath catches slightly on 'feel so far away'. Gaze is gentle, holding the memory without grasping at it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ラジオの選曲、お気に入りの曲、流れたな。
lines.en: The songs we loved came on the radio. I remember.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Slight lift in pitch as the memory lands. Not emphatic — just true. Voice settles back down at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 映画の見どころ、二人で話し合ったね。
lines.en: We'd sit and talk about what we saw in the movies. Remember?
lines.style: Warm and inviting — opening the memory toward him. Rhythm is conversational, intimate. The question at the end is gentle, drawing him in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃のお前、ピアスを着けてた写真、あるよ。
lines.en: There's a photo of you when you were young, wearing earrings. I have it.
lines.style: Tenderly observant. Slight wonder in the tone — as if seeing her young self still surprises him. Not urgent. Just offering what he sees.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お友達からの葉書、整理しなきゃね。
lines.en: I should sort through those postcards from friends sometime. So many to go through.
lines.style: Practical affection with underlying warmth. Slight sigh of pleasant overwhelm. Not rushed. A small note of 'I'll get to it, they're worth keeping' in the trailing thought.
